materiality_attribution.what_this_run_can_attribute: Raw-byte change against wave 1 (2026-10-24) and text stability across two reads 30 seconds apart on 2026-10-27.
materiality_attribution.what_this_run_cannot_attribute: Text-level change against wave 1: wave 1 captured only a raw sha256, never an extracted-text digest, so a raw delta cannot be resolved into "the visible text changed" versus "the page changed elsewhere".
materiality_attribution.consequence: Wave 1 is not retro-fittable for text-level materiality. The text digests captured here are the baseline for wave 3, which will attribute materiality exactly.

limitations: A byte delta on a page whose extracted text also moves between two reads 30 seconds apart is reported as NOT_DISTINGUISHABLE_CHURN, never as a material change.
CANDIDATE_MATERIAL_CHANGE is a candidate, not a finding about a third party. Materiality is a human adjudication and is not automated.
Absence on the landed URL is not absence elsewhere. Refusals are recorded in their own state and never converted to a zero.
No third-party naming is published from a delta without human release approval.
